dedupe_keys.name: australia hospital and ambulance road accessibility layers

description: This collection estimates road distance and travel time to Australian hospitals grouped by clinical services and to ambulance stations. Kiki Adhinugraha and collaborators combine OpenStreetMap roads, AIHW hospital information, ambulance locations, administrative boundaries and sampled residential addresses. Figshare version 2 supplies GeoJSON layers and CSV summaries in GDA2020, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is national and includes road nodes, approximately twenty thousand sampled residential addresses and area-level summaries; the input sources have different reference dates. The provider reports average travel-time discrepancies against Google Maps estimates of three minutes in urban areas, ten in regional areas and ninety in remote areas. Those errors, restricted road classes and an unexplained sixteen-service boundary in the stated hospital groups are limitations. Modellers could compare healthcare-access scenarios or assess road-disruption exposure. data-openstreetmap and data-aihw-myhospitals-api are identified source resources. No geospatial layer or residential address was downloaded, and travel times were not independently checked.
name: Australia hospital and ambulance road-accessibility layers
